default_mode_note: Analytic Scan is the startup default; Standard View remains selectable with T.
rule: Planet surface views support lightweight toggleable vision filters on T. Filters must visibly affect the view, update UI, and provide several distinct modes without replacing core rover/drone gameplay. Analytic Scan is the mandatory entry/default world camera mode to simulate old robotic vision. Radiation exposure increases distortion, while each world applies its own lower-saturation baseline.
